explanation: A small population survived on Wrangel Island, off north-east Siberia, until about 4,000 years ago. The pyramid was finished around 2560 BC, about 4,500 years ago.

claims.text: Woolly mammoths survived on Wrangel Island until about 4,000 years ago, after the Great Pyramid of Giza was built.
Wrangel Island lies in the Arctic Ocean off north-east Siberia.
The Great Pyramid of Giza was completed around 2560 BC.

evidence.summaryExcerpt: Dates vary by source. Britannica Kids says the Great Pyramid of Khufu in Egypt was begun in about 2550 BC. Another Britannica article gives completion around 2470 BCE. A third source puts Khufu's reign at 2551-2528 to 2509-2483, depending on the chronology used. So 2560 BC is a little earlier than most estimates, which cluster around 2550 BC for the start and the early-to-mid 25th century BCE for completion.

claimResults.note: Britannica entries date the pyramid's completion anywhere from about 2560 to about 2470 BC, depending on chronology, so 'completed around 2560 BC' conflicts as written. Search counted under p.hist.0173.
